# Ashir Arif — AI Automation Developer & MERN Stack Developer

> Freelance AI Automation Developer and MERN Stack Developer available for worldwide remote projects.

## About

Ashir Arif is a full-stack developer and AI automation specialist based in Pakistan. He builds intelligent automation systems and production-grade web applications for international clients.

**Specializations:**
- AI-powered chatbot development (OpenAI, Claude)
- Voice agent development for phone and web interactions
- End-to-end workflow automation using n8n, Make (Integromat), and Zapier
- LLM integration into business systems
- Full-stack web development with Next.js, React, Node.js, MongoDB, and TypeScript

## Services

### AI Automation
- **AI Chatbots**: Intelligent customer support, lead qualification, and onboarding bots powered by OpenAI and Claude
- **Voice Agents**: Automated AI voice agents for inbound/outbound calls and voice-based workflows
- **Workflow Automation**: End-to-end business process automation eliminating manual, repetitive tasks
- **LLM Integration**: Connecting OpenAI, Claude, and other LLMs into existing business tools and databases
- **Lead Generation Automation**: Automated pipelines for capturing, qualifying, and nurturing leads

### Web Development
- **SaaS Platforms**: Production-grade multi-tenant apps with Next.js and Node.js
- **E-commerce Systems**: Full e-commerce with Stripe, inventory management, and admin dashboards
- **Admin Dashboards**: Data-rich dashboards with real-time updates
- **REST & GraphQL APIs**: Scalable backend APIs with Express.js and Node.js

## Tech Stack

**AI Automation Tools**: n8n, Make (Integromat), Zapier, OpenAI API, Claude API
**Frontend**: Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion
**Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, Bun.js, GraphQL
**Databases**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase, Prisma
**DevOps**: Vercel, Railway, Docker, GitHub
